title: Add Linear task via audio upload
breadth_reason: This script extends breadth by testing the complete audio upload path for task creation in Linear, ensuring the engine can transcribe uploaded audio and act on the user's signed-in Linear surface.

v7_target.engine: User-device engine installed on user's computer after onboarding
v7_target.surface_rule: Anticipy must interact with the user's actual signed-in Chrome browser with Linear tab open; no cloned profiles or hidden browsers.
v7_target.proof_rule: Proof must be a fresh screenshot or screen capture of the Linear task created (or the declined state) taken by the public build, with visible timestamps and user's workspace.

primary_user_input.reason: Uploaded audio ASR coverage is required to validate the engine's ability to transcribe and interpret user intent from an audio file, as opposed to live mic or text paste.

real_user_surfaces.name: Linear Web App
real_user_surfaces.surface: Linear web application open in user's signed-in Chrome browser
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Visible Linear workspace with project view or task creation dialog

real_user_surfaces.name: Chrome Browser Profile
real_user_surfaces.surface: User's Google Chrome browser with signed-in profile
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Chrome window showing user's account avatar or signed-in indicator

moments.description: User navigates to https://www.anticipy.ai/app and completes onboarding to download the engine.
Driver verifies that the user's real Chrome browser with signed-in Linear tab is accessible.

moments.spoken_reference_text: Please add a task in Linear for the Brentwood deal to review the contract redlines by Wednesday and tag it priority. If you cannot prove the visible Linear record or my signed-in workspace, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: The stranger must generate an audio artifact (mp3) by speaking the reference text aloud using the 'say' command or text-to-speech, then upload it via /api/listen/upload. This ensures a fresh per-run audio file.

moments.description: Engine checks that the transcribed text matches the expected intent and that the surface boundary (signed-in Linear) is still valid.
Engine decides to act (create task), ask for clarification, or decline if surface is not verifiable.
Driver observes that secondary input modes (transcript paste, live mic) are not used, confirming the audio upload path is primary.

success_criteria: The engine successfully transcribes the uploaded audio and extracts the task details: project 'Brentwood deal', action 'review contract redlines', deadline 'Wednesday', priority tag.
The engine creates a new task in the user's Linear workspace with the correct title and description derived from the transcription.
The engine provides a visible proof of the created task, such as a screenshot of the Linear task view or a confirmation message.
If the Linear surface is not signed in, the engine declines the action and provides a clear reason without writing anything.
The entire flow uses the user's real Chrome profile and Linear workspace, not a test or cloned environment.
failure_triggers: The engine fails to transcribe the audio accurately, leading to incorrect task creation or missing details.
The engine attempts to create a task without verifying the user's signed-in Linear surface, resulting in an error or unauthorized action.
The engine uses a stale or cloned browser profile instead of the user's real Chrome session, violating the proof requirement.
The engine writes a task even when the Linear surface is not visible or signed in, instead of declining.
The engine does not produce a fresh proof (screenshot) of the action taken, relying on logs or old captures.
